text:
Maya: Quick pulse — we need to lock the GA acceptance criteria for SLA/monitoring/pricing by EOD tomorrow. Three asks: owners for SLA tiers, exact alert thresholds for latency/error, and any pricing caveats for burst vs reserved.
Aj: For SLA tiers, eng suggests: Bronze = best-effort, Silver = 95th<=120ms, Gold = 95th<=80ms + 99th<=200ms. Can we scope Gold to Dedicated only? :thinking_face:
Lina: @Aj Dedicated-only for Gold makes sense operationally. For alerts I'll propose: page at 95th>Gold threshold for 3m or error rate>0.5% sustained 5m. Runbook link: https://wiki/redwood/sre/ga-sla-runbook
Priya: I'll draft the SLA doc section and example Service Level table. Need the canonical wording for "backfill" and the rollback policy from Product. Also want clarification: do we expose per-route latency in Console by GA?
Maya: We should expose per-route 95th and error % for Silver/Gold. Priya, add a 'how to read your SLA' snippet. Frank, any pricing flags?
Frank: Pricing note — reserved capacity customers get a 10% unit discount and a guaranteed throughput SLA. For hosted burst, call out that we best-effort throttling may occur; add a billing footnote: "burst beyond quota billed at overage rate; capacity not guaranteed." I'll send exact phrasing shortly.
Aj: Implementation flag: need a feature switch to enable per-route telemetry for private deployments. I'll file a short PR and assign to @lina for infra approval.
Lina: Ack, will review infra implications. Also proposing a light synthetic probe that emits to Datadog every 5m per-region; alerting rule exported as:
```
alert: latency_slo_violation
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)) > THRESHOLD
for: 3m
```
Maya: Nice. Two operational questions: 1) Who is primary oncall for SLA breaches for GA? 2) Do we want an automatic fallback model for high error rates?
Aj: Primary oncall = eng-platform first shift, then eng-sre. Fallback model: yes — config option to route to a lower-quality but cheaper variant automatically.
Priya: Docs will include the fallback behavior and a short FAQ. I'll need screenshots of Console toggles — @Aj can you drop them in the doc PR?
Maya: Action items: Aj -> PR for telemetry + screenshots (due 48h). Lina -> draft runbook alerts (24h). Priya -> SLA + FAQ draft (48h). Frank -> billing footnote + pricing table (24h). I'll consolidate and circulate for sign-off.
release-bot: Deployment window for GA config changes scheduled 2026-03-28 02:00 UTC (maintenance). :calendar:
Maya: Thanks team — if anyone can't hit their ETA, flag here now. :pray:
